title: Total transaction volume per account, 2025
prompt: For each account, what's the total transaction volume (sum of amount) in 2025? Transactions start at one row each — what do you need a row to represent instead?
grain: Starts at one row per transaction; ends at one row per account.
metricDefinition: sum(amount) per account, for transactions in 2025.
referenceSql: SELECT account_id, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id
